title: csnotes sources tag <prefix> <course...>: write course tags
description:
Bulk-tag sources by ID or path prefix (same expansion as process --source).
- Write courses: into each source file's YAML frontmatter (create the frontmatter if missing; preserve other keys/body byte-for-byte as far as practical) AND update the manifest entry, so it takes effect immediately and survives reconcile --reset.
- --dry-run shows the plan; --replace vs default add/merge; 'sources untag' or --remove for undo.
- AI conversations with .json sidecars: decide whether the sidecar needs the tag too (check what reconcile reads).
- Validate course names against active_courses plus courses seen in sessions; warn (don't fail) on unknown names.
- Takes the manifest lock.
SU vault first pass (for the user to run):
  Textbooks/Zybooks-CPSC5001-McKee, Textbooks/Zybooks-CPSC5001-summary, Textbooks/Starting-Out-with-Java -> CPSC5001 CPSC5002
  AI-Conversations/*/Java-* -> CPSC5001 CPSC5002
  AI-Conversations/Claude/Cpp-* -> CPSC5005
  Functional-programming-concepts-across-languages, Other/BigO-from-online -> user's call (untagged = everywhere).
